title: Generate a company name
summary: Branding: the agent generates brand-name candidates and scores each on domain availability, social handles, and trademark conflicts.

parts.title: Generate name candidates
parts.guidance: Generate distinct naming directions from the product's purpose, customers, languages and constraints. Give exact spellings, pronunciation and the association each name creates. Flag language questions for a fluent reviewer, then recommend candidates for availability and conflict checks.

parts.title: Check domain + social + trademark intel
parts.guidance: Check each candidate's exact domain, priority social handles and similar trademarks for the intended markets and goods or services. Link the searches and date the observations. USPTO guidance for a U.S. clearance search includes federal records and common-law use. Flag material conflicts for a qualified trademark adviser; an available domain or an empty search result does not establish legal clearance.

references.title: Comprehensive clearance search for similar trademarks

parts.title: Present ranked candidates
parts.guidance: Rank the checked names by audience fit, pronunciation, distinctiveness, workable domains and handles, and unresolved conflicts. Explain the tradeoffs using the search evidence, and identify which further check could change the recommendation. Carry the founder's selected spelling into the brand brief. While selection is open, label the shortlist as recommendations awaiting a choice.

metadata.supportReason: An agent generates candidates and scores each on domain availability, social handles, and trademark conflicts via search APIs.
